name: summary-quality-funnel
description: Reference-free summary scoring with hard gates, Scorer/Reviewer/Report Agents, charts, and auditable traces.

interface.shortDescription: Hard gates, three-agent review, charts, and audit trails
interface.longDescription: Evaluate article-summary pairs with deterministic hard gates and relevance screening, then use isolated Scorer, Reviewer, and Report Agent workflows to produce scores, labels, evidence, charts, a concise English Markdown report, and a complete audit trail. Runtime scoring does not require reference summaries.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this article-summary pair and return a score, label, evidence, and complete review trace.
Evaluate and rank this summary batch, then generate an English chart report under 800 words.
